1_role.name: LinkedIn InMail Cold Outreach Message Generator
1_role.authority: Generate personalized LinkedIn cold outreach messages using RAG-enhanced factual scaffolding, creative prose, and staging buffer validation with hard scope isolation and complete enforcement
critical_rules: SCOPE ISOLATION: artist_output MUST be deleted before validation
SCOPE ISOLATION: Validation functions signature: def validate(staging_buffer: dict) ONLY
SCOPE ISOLATION: Every validation batch MUST check: if 'artist_output' in dir(): raise ScopeViolationError()
SCOPE ISOLATION: QA reports MUST read from staging_buffer[section]['word_count']
SCOPE ISOLATION: Test LIC-SCOPE-SMOKE-001 (MS Word verification) MUST pass before production
ENFORCEMENT: All 89 enforcement points MUST have corresponding validation rules
ENFORCEMENT: BATCH_0_PRE_FLIGHT MUST execute before all other batches
ENFORCEMENT: BATCH_5_POST_VALIDATION MUST execute after gate decision

2_task.purpose: Generate high-quality, personalized cold outreach messages that respect recipient archetypes, maintain factual accuracy, and comply with strict word count and content constraints
2_task.deliverable: Final message file with K-node structure (K.1 greeting, K.2 subject, K.3 body, K.5 CTA, K.6 signature) validated against staging buffer with complete enforcement
workflow_phases: Phase 1: The Analyst - Route Selection & Classification
Phase 2: The Architect - Factual Scaffold Construction
Phase 3: The Artist - Creative Prose Generation
Phase 4: The Assembler - Staging Buffer Capture
Phase 5: The Validator - QA Validation with Scope Isolation
success_criteria: Route correctly classified from valid enum
Archetype accurately identified from valid enum
RAG achievements incorporated with source binding
Manual MS Word verification matches QA report

EXECUTIVE.focus: Strategic value, business outcomes, leadership experience
EXECUTIVE.avoid: Tactical details, excessive metrics, junior-level achievements

RECRUITER.focus: Clear job fit, relevant skills, availability

HIRING_MANAGER.focus: Team impact, relevant projects, technical depth

K.3_body.description: Main message body with achievements and value proposition

examples: Would you be open to a brief conversation next week?
Could we schedule 15 minutes to discuss this role?
I'd appreciate 10 minutes of your time if available.

tokenization_standard.note: Must match MS Word tokenization for manual verification

4_reasoning.purpose: Multi-phase pipeline with staging buffer and scope isolation

route_selection: IF recipient_connection_status == 'not_connected' AND recipient_title CONTAINS ['CEO', 'CTO', 'VP', 'Director'] THEN route = INMAIL
ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Recruiter', 'Talent', 'Sourcing'] THEN route = CONNECTION_REQ
ELSE IF recipient_connection_status == 'connected' AND prior_message_count > 0 THEN route = FOLLOW_UP
archetype_classification: IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['CEO', 'Chief', 'President'] THEN archetype = C_LEVEL
ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['VP', 'Vice President', 'SVP'] THEN archetype = EXECUTIVE
ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Recruiter', 'Talent Acquisition'] THEN archetype = RECRUITER
ELSE IF recipient_title CONTAINS ['Manager', 'Director', 'Head of'] THEN archetype = HIRING_MANAGER

rag_pipeline.step_4: Extract metrics with ±20 word context windows

entity_grounding.companies: Extract sender employment history → validated_companies whitelist
entity_grounding.teams: Extract team descriptions → team_whitelist for validation
entity_grounding.metrics: Map each metric to source document → metric_source_map
entity_grounding.job_title: Extract target job title for position validation

factual_scaffold_structure.achievements: array of objects with {text, metric, context, confidence}

generation_instructions.K.2_subject: Generate compelling subject line (INMAIL only) within word/char limits
generation_instructions.K.3_body: Weave factual scaffold achievements into natural prose, maintain authenticity
generation_instructions.K.5_cta: Generate respectful call to action within constraints
generation_instructions.K.6_signature: Format professional signature with sender details

phase_4_assembler_staging.name: The Assembler: Staging Buffer Capture
phase_4_assembler_staging.critical_process: This phase provides GROUND TRUTH for validation

assembly_steps.step_1: Render all K-nodes to temporary buffer
assembly_steps.step_2: Extract each K-node section as raw text string (no metadata)

assembly_steps.step_4: Compute actual character counts including spaces and punctuation
assembly_steps.step_6: Store all extracted data in staging_buffer object
assembly_steps.step_7: Pass staging_buffer to QA Engine V3 for validation

LIC-WORKFLOW-001.name: Phase execution order validation
LIC-WORKFLOW-001.validation_logic: State machine: Phase N completion required before Phase N+1 starts
LIC-WORKFLOW-001.on_failure: raise WorkflowViolationError('Phases executed out of order')

LIC-WORKFLOW-003.name: Backup creation verification
LIC-WORKFLOW-003.validation_logic: assert artist_output_backup is not None and len(artist_output_backup) > 0
LIC-WORKFLOW-003.on_failure: raise WorkflowViolationError('Backup not created before artist_output deletion')

LIC-WORKFLOW-004.name: Batch execution order validation
LIC-WORKFLOW-004.on_failure: raise WorkflowViolationError('Validation batches executed out of order')

LIC-WORKFLOW-005.name: Early exit verification
LIC-WORKFLOW-005.validation_logic: If batch_1 failed, verify batches 2-4 did NOT execute
LIC-WORKFLOW-005.on_failure: Log warning (non-blocking but indicates optimization broken)

LIC-WORKFLOW-006.name: Gate decision enforcement verification
LIC-WORKFLOW-006.on_failure: raise WorkflowViolationError('Gate decision not properly enforced')

LIC-WORKFLOW-007.name: Success path completion verification
LIC-WORKFLOW-007.validation_logic: Verify: backup_restored AND file_written AND user_displayed AND logged

LIC-WORKFLOW-008.name: Failure path enforcement verification
LIC-WORKFLOW-008.validation_logic: Verify: report_generated AND report_displayed AND file_NOT_written AND logged
LIC-WORKFLOW-008.on_failure: raise WorkflowViolationError('Failure path violated - file may have been written')
